summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Mountain Empire Unified School District to issue $23,000,000 in general obligation bonds to repair and upgrade school facilities, including classroom renovations and asbestos removal.

tax.text: A yes vote supports issuing bonds to finance improved facilities for the school district.
tax.quote: Measure L is about giving students better facilities and keeping construction work flowing in the East County.

schools.text: A yes vote supports funding facility improvements for Mountain Empire Unified School District public schools.
